items.originalTitle: Remembering Sir Patrick Stewart's unforgettable moment on the F1 podium with Daniel Ricciardo
items.summaryEn: Actor Patrick Stewart has died at the age of 86. At the 2017 Canadian Grand Prix podium, he drank champagne from Daniel Ricciardo's race boot, creating one of Formula 1's most memorable podium moments.
detailZh: 悼念帕特里克·斯图尔特爵士与丹尼尔·里卡多在F1领奖台上令人难忘的时刻
《星际迷航》和《X战警》演员去世，享年86岁；他在2017年加拿大大奖赛上留下了F1最令人难忘的领奖台瞬间之一
领奖台：帕特里克·斯图尔特用赛车靴喝香槟，丹尼尔·里卡多，红牛车队
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计，以及让赛车超越运动本身的故事。
虽然帕特里克·斯图尔特爵士因《星际迷航》和《X战警》等系列作品而闻名，但F1车迷会记住他是一位令人难忘的赛车运动爱好者。2017年在蒙特利尔，他在领奖台上用丹尼尔·里卡多的赛车靴喝香槟，证明了他有多么热情。
这位电影传奇人物在洛杉矶的家中去世，享年86岁，据称他与阿尔茨海默病和路易体痴呆症进行了短暂而私密的斗争。但在去世之前，他度过了不可思议的一生，不仅通过无数慈善事例奉献社会，还享受了生活中更美好的事物——其中之一就是2017年加拿大大奖赛领奖台上的香槟。
蒙特利尔站冠军刘易斯·汉密尔顿与队友瓦尔特利·博塔斯站在一起，而里卡多为红牛车队获得第三名。斯图尔特主持了采访，这位演员以他著名的戏剧性表达开场：
“恭喜你，刘易斯。你可能会说，没有什么比在蒙特利尔的周日下午沿着河边愉快而安静地驾驶更美好的了。但这次有点不同，不是吗？”他说。但真正登上全球头条的是他与里卡多的对话。
这位澳大利亚车手已经把自己的“鞋饮”变成了标志性的领奖台庆祝方式——用自己比赛时穿的赛车靴喝香槟，而蒙特利尔的观众知道接下来会发生什么。
“我觉得我听到了什么……我得做点什么，”里卡多说，随后他从靴子里一饮而尽香槟，然后把靴子递给了斯图尔特。
当时76岁的斯图尔特毫不犹豫，从靴子里喝了一口，下方车迷顿时爆发出巨大欢呼。
“这都快成仪式了！好年份！干杯！”斯图尔特说。
汉密尔顿前一天刚刚追平了艾尔顿·塞纳的65个杆位纪录，对此印象深刻。
“我为你做到这一点感到骄傲！这是我做不到的事。你看到他的脚有多湿了吗？”汉密尔顿说道。
斯图尔特的回复迅速走红。
“我不在乎——这是我第一次登上领奖台；谁的鞋我都愿意喝！”
有趣的场面还在继续，斯图尔特问汉密尔顿从杆位领跑每一圈是什么感觉。“我马上告诉你，但你能读懂我的心思吗？”汉密尔顿问道。
“能。你很高兴！”斯图尔特回答道，随后又带动人群高呼：“加拿大，你们听到了吗？蒙特利尔——听听他说的话！”
这段视频在网上广泛传播。“首位在加拿大大奖赛上用鞋喝酒的骑士，”天空体育当时说道。
2024年离开F1的里卡多在其职业生涯中又多次用鞋喝酒，但很少有哪次能比得上他与让-吕克·皮卡德舰长共享的那一次。
detailEn: Remembering Sir Patrick Stewart's unforgettable moment on the F1 podium with Daniel Ricciardo
Star Trek and X-Men actor, who has died aged 86, delivered one of F1’s most memorable podium moments at the 2017 Canadian Grand Prix
Podium: Patrick Stewart, does a Shoey, Daniel Ricciardo, Red Bull Racing
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

While Sir Patrick Stewart made his name in franchises such as Star Trek and X-Men, he'll be remembered by Formula 1 fans as an unforgettable lover of motorsport. And in Montreal in 2017, he proved just how passionate he was by drinking champagne from Daniel Ricciardo's race boot on the podium.

The film legend died aged 86 at his home in Los Angeles after what was described as a brief and private battle with both Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy body dementia. But before his passing, he had an incredible life where not only did he give through countless examples of philanthropy, but he also enjoyed the finer things life had to offer - one of them being champagne on the podium of the 2017 Canadian Grand Prix.

Lewis Hamilton, winner of the Montreal race, stood alongside his team-mate Valtteri Bottas, while Ricciardo had finished third for Red Bull. Stewart led the interviews as the actor opened with his famous theatrical delivery:

“Congratulations, Lewis. You might say that there’s nothing like a pleasant, quiet drive along the river on a Sunday afternoon in Montreal. But this was a little different, wasn’t it?” he said. But it was his conversation with Ricciardo that made headlines globally.
The Australian had made the shoey his signature podium celebration, drinking champagne from his own race boot, and the crowd in Montreal knew what was coming.
“I think I hear something… I have to do something,” Ricciardo said, before downing champagne from his boot and then handing it to Stewart.
The then-76-year-old did not hesitate, drinking from the boot to huge cheers from the fans below.
“This is becoming a ritual! Good vintage! Cheers!” Stewart said.
Hamilton, who had just matched Ayrton Senna’s record of 65 pole positions the day before, was impressed.
“I’m proud of you for doing that! It’s something I couldn’t do. Have you seen how sweaty his feet are?” said Hamilton.
Stewart’s reply quickly went viral.
“I don’t care – I’m on the podium for the first time; I’ll drink out of anybody’s shoe!”
The fun continued when Stewart asked Hamilton how it felt to lead every lap from pole position. “I’ll tell you that in a second, but can you read my mind?” Hamilton asked.
“Yes. You are happy!” Stewart replied, before rallying the crowd with: “Do you hear that, Canada? Montreal – what he said!”
The clip was shared widely online. “The first knight of the realm to do a shoey at the Canadian GP," Sky Sports said at the time.
Ricciardo, who left F1 in 2024, went on to do several more shoeys during his career, but few matched the one he shared with Captain Jean-Luc Picard.

items.originalTitle: Lewis Hamilton: “I’m built differently” as he eyes F1 career into 2030s
items.summaryEn: Seven-time Formula 1 world champion Lewis Hamilton says he is "built differently" as he discusses the possibility of extending his career long enough to race at the new African Grand Prix.
detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿：“我与众不同”，他展望2030年代继续征战F1
这位法拉利车手表示年龄不是参加新非洲大奖赛的障碍，并坚称自己的反应“比这里一些最年轻的人还快”。
致法拉利车迷。来自马拉内罗及更远地方的最新法拉利F1新闻、车手动态、技术分析和比赛反应。
七届F1世界冠军刘易斯·汉密尔顿在讨论将职业生涯延长到足以参加新的非洲大奖赛的可能性时，坚称自己“与众不同”。
F1最近宣布与卢旺达达成一项为期10年的协议，将在基加利附近的一条新赛道举办比赛，该赛事预计将在2030年代初加入赛历。听到这个消息后，他被问及对这份合同的看法，此前他长期呼吁F1重返该大洲。
他开玩笑说，自己得延长职业生涯才能在那里比赛，但他有多认真呢？
“首先，过去10年里，你们这里从未有过像我这样的人。所以我觉得我的构造与众不同，”他说。“当然，随着年龄增长，前方会有我无法预见的挑战。但在这条路上，在这段旅程中，一直有太多先入为主的观念，认为你的反应时间会下降。
“你看到我上一场比赛中的反应了吗？我的反应比这里一些最年轻的人还要快。所以有很多工具可以利用，来让自己和头脑保持敏锐。我想，只要你愿意牺牲一切——如果我现在的状态就是如此，我会继续这样做。我无法说四年后我是否还想继续做我正在做的事，但我现在仍然热爱我所做的事。”
“我依然全力以赴，在可预见的未来也会如此。我44岁时还能否与20岁的车手竞争，谁知道呢？但41岁的我能够与20岁的车手竞争。所以时间会证明我30多岁时是否还在这里。我们拭目以待。
“但我绝不想在已经没有竞争力的情况下还赖着不走。我不想开着车却明显掉队。我的反应下降了，我的动力下降了，我的速度也下降了，去年所有人都这么以为。但我已经用表现证明了所有人都错了，我会继续努力这样做。”
汉密尔顿在车手积分榜上排名第三，在争夺第二名的较量中仅落后乔治·拉塞尔一分。但这位英国车手表示，这场争夺并非优先事项。
“我不会说这毫无意义，但这不是我关注的重点。我认为赢得总冠军才是任何人真正必须在意的事情。”
相反，汉密尔顿希望为他的车队锁定制造商锦标赛第二名，该车队去年排名第四，并将利用最后五场比赛为2027年做准备。
“我真的把这五场比赛当作明年赛车的测试平台。花时间与我们的空气动力学主管交流，讨论车辆动力学，我们可以在哪些方面改进这辆车，以及如何保持底盘的优良特性，例如，今年底盘一直很棒。”
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton: “I’m built differently” as he eyes F1 career into 2030s
The Ferrari driver says age is no barrier to racing at the new African Grand Prix, insisting his reactions are “faster than some of the youngest people here”.
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
Seven-time Formula 1 world champion Lewis Hamilton insists he is “built differently” as he discusses the idea of extending his career long enough to race at the new African Grand Prix.

F1 recently announced a 10-year deal with Rwanda to host a race at a new circuit near Kigali, with the event expected to join the calendar in the early 2030s. Upon hearing the news, he was asked his thoughts on the contract after he had long campaigned for a return to the continent.
He joked that he would have to extend his career to race there, but how serious is he?

"Firstly, you've never had anyone like me here in the last 10 years. So I feel that I'm built differently," he said. "Of course, there are challenges up ahead that I can't foresee that come with age. But along this way, along this journey, there have been so many preconceived ideas about the fact that your reaction time drops off.

"Did you see my reaction in the last race? My reaction's faster than some of the youngest people here. So there are lots of tools that you can utilise to continue to keep yourself and mind sharp. I guess as long as you're willing to sacrifice everything, which I continue to if I am right now. I can't say in four years whether I want to continue to do what I'm doing, but I love what I'm doing still now.

"I'm still all in and I will be for the foreseeable future. Whether or not I can compete at 44 with a 20-year-old, who knows? But at 41 I can compete with a 20-year-old. So time will tell whether I'm here in the 30s. We'll see.

"But I never want to overstay my welcome in the sense of still not having the performance. I don't want to be walking - driving around with that really dropped off. My reactions dropped off, my drive's dropped off, and my pace has dropped off, which everyone assumed last year. But I've proved everyone wrong with that and I will continue to try to do so."
Hamilton is third in the drivers’ standings, just one point behind George Russell in the fight for second. But the Briton said that battle is not a priority.
“I’m not going to say it doesn’t mean anything, but it’s not something I focus on. I think winning the championship is the only thing anybody must really care about.”
Instead, Hamilton wants to secure second in the constructors’ championship for his team, which finished fourth last year, and will use the final five races to prepare for 2027.

“I’m really using these five races as a test bench for next year’s car. Spending time speaking with our head of aerodynamics, talking about vehicle dynamics, where we can improve this car, how we can keep the goodness of the chassis, for example, which has been great this year.”

积分榜领先者基米·安东内利因病毒感染康复期间被免除媒体职责，梅赛德斯预计这位意大利车手将在周五练习赛重返赛道。凯迪拉克的瓦尔特利·博塔斯也因身体不适缺席媒体日，这支美国车队称这是预防措施。
墨西哥站是继上周美国大奖赛之后、下周巴西大奖赛之前的三连赛第二站。2026赛季最后九个比赛周末被安排为三个三连赛，中间各有一周休息。
在墨西哥接受媒体采访时，维斯塔潘被问及这段连续比赛有多艰难。
“当然，连续三周对身体总是相当艰难。有时候你可能会有点不走运，比如肠胃不适，”这位荷兰车手解释道。
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，向红牛车队的杆位得主丹尼尔·里卡多表示祝贺。
"但通常每年这个时候，不仅是车手，还有机械师和车队里的人员都会生病。因为你的身体承受了很多压力。但到了某个时刻，它当然也会告诉你需要一点恢复期。
"这是你需要时刻注意的事情。有些年份情况会好一些，有些年份则差一些。我觉得随着你经历的赛季越多，你也会对此有所了解。有时候有些事情是你无法预防的。但可以肯定的是，这总是非常艰难的。
"对我来说，最艰难的部分是你无法在中间回家与家人团聚。如今，这对我来说是连续三场比赛周末中我不太喜欢的一点。"
detailEn: Max Verstappen discusses toll of F1 calendar after two drivers fall ill
Max Verstappen has highlighted the physical toll of Formula 1's triple-headers
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Four-time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen says it is "normal" for F1 drivers and team members to fall ill at this stage of the season after two drivers missed Thursday's media day in Mexico City.

Championship leader Kimi Antonelli was excused from media duties while he recovers from a viral illness, with Mercedes expecting the Italian driver to return to the track for Friday practice. Cadillac's Valtteri Bottas also missed media day through illness, with the American outfit describing it as a precaution.

Mexico is the second race of a triple-header after the United States Grand Prix last week and ahead of the Brazilian Grand Prix next week. The last nine race weekends of the 2026 season are arranged into three triple-headers with one-week breaks in between them.
While speaking to the media in Mexico, Verstappen was asked how tough the run of races had been.
"It is, of course, always quite tough on your body, like three weeks in a row. Sometimes you can get a little bit unlucky with whatever, a stomach bug," the Dutchman explained.
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, congratulates pole man Daniel Ricciardo, Red Bull Racing

"But it's normally around this time of the year that not only drivers, but mechanics and people in the team get sick. Because your body can take a lot of stress. But at one point, of course, it also tells you when it needs a little recovery phase.

"That's something that you need to stay on top of. And some years it goes a bit better than others. I think you try to learn about it as well a little bit with the more seasons that you do. Sometimes some things are things that you can't prevent. But for sure, it's always very tough.
"For me, the toughest bit is that you can't really go home in between to be back with the family. That, for me, is nowadays something that I do not really enjoy about triple-headers."

items.originalTitle: Max Verstappen jokes about Daniel Ricciardo's Le Mans ambition: "He's a smart man picking me!"
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘戏谑丹尼尔·里卡多对勒芒的雄心："他是个明智的人，选了我！"
维斯塔潘的前红牛车队队友在梦中列出了一份参加勒芒24小时耐力赛的阵容，提到了这位荷兰人
丹尼尔·里卡多，第三车手，红牛车队，马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队
马克斯·维斯塔潘开玩笑说，前红牛车队队友丹尼尔·里卡多选择他是明智的，因为有可能组成一个三人组参加未来的勒芒24小时耐力赛。
里卡多自从第二次离开F1，在2024年为红牛的姐妹车队小红牛车队参赛后，就没有参加过任何赛车系列赛。
然而，在接受Beyond the Grid播客采访时，这位澳大利亚赛车冠军表示，他可能会被参加未来在法国La Circuit de la Sarthe周围举办的24小时耐力赛的邀请所吸引，并提到了维斯塔潘和另一位前红牛车队队友塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔作为他梦寐以求的车队阵容。
当被问及他会选择谁作为搭档时，里卡多回答说：“我不想给他施加压力，但显然，马克斯的名字会排在名单的前列。”
“我们在2018年当然讨论过红牛，以及如果怎样，如果怎样；我试图在职业生涯结束时报复车队，所以这可能是一种我们可以给人们他们想要的东西的方式。”
维斯塔潘之前提到过有朝一日想在勒芒赛道参赛，他已经将F1的优先事项与GT赛事的参赛相结合，今年参加了纽博格林24小时耐力赛和波特马奥的GT世界挑战赛决赛。
在周末的墨西哥城大奖赛之前，关于里卡多的评论，维斯塔潘回答说：“他是个聪明人，选择了我来驾驶这辆车。”
“但我们还得看看。这取决于很多因素。对我来说，如果我想这么做，我想做得很好，做好充分的准备。”
“目前我做不到这一点。我没有足够的时间来投入到勒芒项目中，因为我还在做其他 Formula 1 之外的事情。”
里卡多表示勒芒可能成为选项，这是他首次公开表达想要重返赛车场，尽管维斯塔潘透露这个消息对他来说并不新鲜，因为他已经和里卡多沟通过。
“是的，我们已经谈过了，”这位四次世界冠军确认。
“但我也认为，无论是从我的角度还是他的角度，我认为我们都不是那种总是需要分享一切的人。我们在幕后讨论了很多事情。”
“我想他自己也这么说了。他并不认为自己会整个赛季都回来，但单场比赛对他来说可能很有兴趣。为什么不呢？但再次强调，如果我们要做这样的事情，他肯定会同意这需要是合适的。这需要是为了赢得比赛的机会。
“要想在整赛季都在做这件事的人面前赢得比赛，你需要准备得非常充分。你只需要找到正确的时机。”
detailEn: Max Verstappen jokes about Daniel Ricciardo's Le Mans ambition: "He's a smart man picking me!"
Verstappen's former Red Bull team-mate named the Dutchman in a dream line-up for a tilt at the Le Mans 24 Hours
Daniel Ricciardo, Third Driver, Red Bull Racing and Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing
Max Verstappen has joked that former Red Bull team-mate Daniel Ricciardo is a "smart man" for picking him in a potential trio for a future Le Mans 24 Hour challenge.
Ricciardo has not taken part in any racing series since leaving F1 for the second time having raced for Red Bull's sister RB squad in 2024.

However, speaking on the Beyond the Grid podcast, the Australian race winner suggested that he would be tempted to take part in a future edition of the 24-hour race around La Circuit de la Sarthe in France, highlighting Verstappen and another former Red Bull team-mate in Sebastian Vettel as a dream line-up.
“I don’t want to put pressure on him, but obviously Max is a name that would be high on the list," replied Ricciardo when asked who he would choose for a partnership.

"We talked about Red Bull obviously in 2018, and what if, and what if; I was trying to get back at the team at the end of my career, so maybe that’s a way that we could give the people what they want."

Verstappen has previously mentioned a desire to one day compete at Le Mans and has dovetailed his F1 priorities with outings in GT racing, taking part in this year's Nurburgring 24 Hours and the GT World Challenge finale at Portimao.
Asked ahead of this weekend's Mexico City GP about Ricciardo's comments, Verstappen replied: "He's a smart man to choose me in the car.
"But we have to see. It just depends on a lot of things. Also for me, if I want to do it, I want to do it properly with really good prep.
"At the moment I cannot do that. I don't have the free time to dedicate to a Le Mans project with all the other things that I'm also doing outside of Formula 1."

Ricciardo's suggestion that Le Mans could be on the table is the first time he has revealed a desire to get back into a race car publicly, though Verstappen revealed that the news was "not new to me" having conversed with Ricciardo.
"Yeah, we have spoken," confirmed the four-time world champion.
"But also, I think either from my side or his side, I don't think we are the types that always need to share everything. We talk about a lot of things in the background.

"I think he said it himself. He doesn't see himself coming back for a whole season but the one-offs can interest him. Why not? But again, I think if we do something like that, he will for sure agree that it needs to be proper. It needs to be for a chance to win.
"For a chance to win against people that do it a whole season, you need to be prepared really well. You just need to find the right timing."
